title: Annotated quickstart screenshots for observability flows
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design and produce a set of annotated onboarding/quickstart screenshots that showcase the Observability dashboards: latency distribution, cost-per-token heatmap, per-route latency breakdown, and end-to-end trace waterfall with model fallback annotations. Assets will be used in the Console Quickstart guide, in-product onboarding tour, and docs landing page.
assets: OBS_qs_latency_histogram_annotated_v1.png - primary histogram with p50/p90/p99 callouts and guidance copy
OBS_qs_cost_heatmap_per_token_v1.png - per-route cost-per-token heatmap with lane labels
OBS_qs_trace_waterfall_fallback_v1.png - trace waterfall showing model routing and fallback arrows
OBS_qs_darkmode_variants_v1.zip - dark mode PNG set and source Figma file references
acceptance_criteria: Three hero screenshots exported at 2x for web and 3x for mobile with annotated hotspots matching copy
Annotations call out: latency SLO band, cache hit indicator, model variant used, and cost-per-token calculation
Figma file to include componentized callouts for reuse in future screenshots
Design review approved by PM and Engineering UI owner
Assets uploaded to Drive and links added to docs quickstart page PR
design_decisions: Use a combined histogram + sparkline for latency to show trend and distribution in a single view
Show cost-per-token as a per-route heatmap instead of a table to reduce cognitive load for new users
Include small inline trace snippets in the histogram tooltip to connect distribution to example traces
Reserve red/orange color only for SLO breaches and use amber for near-SLO to avoid alarm fatigue
